standard_prerequisites.name: Perfect complexes have quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves, via the pseudo-coherent lemma of this chapter and the cohomology perfect lemma
standard_prerequisites.use: Starts the converse: each pullback has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves.

standard_prerequisites.use: Transfers the quasi-coherence question to E itself.

standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes the cohomology sheaves of E are quasi-coherent.

standard_prerequisites.name: The cohomology perfect lemma characterizes perfect complexes among objects with quasi-coherent cohomology by bounded tor-amplitude and pseudo-coherence, both of which descend along fpqc coverings by two lemmas of this chapter

core_obligations: Only-if direction: derived pullback preserves perfect complexes by the cohomology pullback lemma (proof lines 3125-3126).

Converse, quasi-coherence step: each Lf_i^*E is perfect, hence has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves; since f_i is flat, H^p(Lf_i^*E) = f_i^*H^p(E); fpqc descent of quasi-coherent sheaves gives that the cohomology sheaves of E are quasi-coherent (proof lines 3127-3134).

Converse, assembly: with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves established, the characterization of perfect complexes by the cohomology perfect lemma together with fpqc descent of bounded tor-amplitude and fpqc descent of pseudo-coherence gives that E is perfect (proof lines 3135-3139).
proof_roadmap: Descend quasi-coherence of the cohomology sheaves of E (proof lines 3127-3134).
Assemble perfectness of E from descended tor-amplitude and pseudo-coherence (proof lines 3135-3139).
